design: Three fresh workspaces and three persistent sessions. All arms receive the same 10 prompt(s) concurrently in one persistent session each, keeping each provider prompt cache warm so idle eviction cannot bias an arm. Official OpenCode uses the unpatched upstream server; Cuppet uses the live plugin and TST path; DeepSeek Harness uses its persistent workspace session. Every task is evaluated immediately with hidden file, behavior-contract, syntax, network, and scope checks. Per-step token samples include idle gaps; cache share excluding steps after gaps over 180s is reported as idle-adjusted.
